startup.compliance_calendar_desc: Ukulembeshiwa e citendeko fye. Businesi yonse mu Zambia ikwata imilimo iyakonkana. Ukulaba ku ifi kilenga ifitulo ne fyakusanswa. Bomfyeni ino kalenda pa kuteyanya umwaka wenu uwa kukonka amafunde.
startup.compliance_penalty_middle: pa kutuma kwa citshimyo pamo ne nsongela pa ndalama ishishilelipilwa. NAPSA alenga
startup.compliance_penalty_outro: pa fyakulipila ifyashilelipilwa mu nshita. Ukushitisha ukwabula layisensi kilenga ifitulo no kwisalwa na council. Tumeni ama return pa nshita — nangu te kuti mulipile fyonse.
startup.hero_desc: Ukutungulula ukwa cila cabala pa kukonka amafunde ku musango onse uwa kutendeka. KIP alemitungulula ukupitila mu bakalamba bonse ba kulembeshiwa — PACRA, ZRA, NAPSA, NHIMA, WCFCB, na layisensi sha musango — pa kuti tapali icishalwa.
startup.choose_type_title: Ni musango nshi wa businesi ulo mulepanga?
startup.choose_type_desc: Saleni umusango wa businesi yenu pa kupoka inshila ya kulembeshiwa iyapangilwe kuli imwe.
startup.tell_kip_more: Ebeni KIP na fimbi pa businesi yenu
startup.hire_employees_desc: Kilundako NAPSA, NHIMA, na WCFCB pa mashiba ya kulembeshiwa
startup.seeking_incentives_question: Bushe mulefwaya ifyakulambulwa fya kubika indalama (ZDA)?
startup.seeking_incentives_desc: Ku makwebo ayabika K250,000+ nangu ayali mu fisankano ifyacindeme
startup.select_type_prompt: Saleni umusango wa businesi pa muulu pa kutwalilila.
startup.structure_desc: Icipangilo ico mwasala kilashininkisha umulandu wenu, ifyo mulelipila umusonko, ifyo mulesanga indalama, ne milimo yenu iyakukonkana. Bikeni inshita mu kusala bwino — ukwalula icipangilo ku ntanshi kilekabila umulimo wa malamulo.
startup.structure_info_outro: (yawamapo pa kukula, ukubika indalama, ne cicetekelo). Ma NGO na ma cumbi bomfya Registrar of Societies mu cifulo ca PACRA.
startup.roadmap_desc_with_type: Amashiba {count} pa kulembesha businesi yenu iya musango wa {type} bwino bwino. Kandeni pa cishiba cila cimo pa kwisula.
startup.roadmap_desc_no_type: Pwisheni amashiba ya kulembeshiwa aya musango onse — kabili mulungike pa kusala umusango wa businesi yenu mu Cishiba 1.
startup.universal_steps_bold: amashiba 4 ya kulembeshiwa aya musango onse
startup.universal_steps_mid: ayabomba ku makwebo yonse ya mu Zambia.
startup.universal_steps_outro: pa kumona inshila yonse iyapangilwe kuli imwe.
startup.all_forms_desc: PACRA, ZRA, NAPSA, NHIMA, WCFCB, NCC na fimbi — filafwaikwa bwangu kabili filaba iyapepi.
